chunks: They who defame those of the believers who give alms willingly, and deride those who have nothing besides what they earn by their labour (to give in charity), will be derided by God, and will suffer painful punishment.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between muttawwi'un and those who give from their jahd in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse critiques the arrogance of the wealthy who belittle the modest contributions of the poor, emphasizing that sincerity outweighs quantity. It serves as a warning against 'fitnah' (social discord) caused by stinginess and superficial judgment, reinforcing the virtue of voluntary charity (sadaqat) as a means of spiritual purification.
